paragraphs.text: Hakka , also known as the Whispering Raven , is a mystical raven native to Kaldheim .

The god Alrund shares a deep connection with ravens, which serve as his trusted messengers and spies. Alrund possesses the ability to empower these birds, granting them the power to fly freely between different realms to deliver messages and gather intelligence. Among all the ravens, Hakka is Alrund’s favored familiar and constant companion. Like his master, Hakka is distinguished by a single glowing eye and an iridescent sheen that shimmers across his feathers. Hakka is often found perched upon Alrund’s shoulder, softly whispering secrets and information collected by other ravens directly into the god’s ear. When Alrund requires a task done with absolute certainty and discretion, he entrusts it to Hakka, sending the raven on crucial missions.
Kaya is one of the few who notice the raven sitting on Asi ’s shoulder during their encounters.
Following the onset of Tibalt ’s Doomskar , Hakka has traveled widely throughout Bretagard , gathering vital information about the unfolding events and the growing dangers threatening Kaldheim.
